summary: Frontend-only iteration 9: validated client feedback fixes (removed WA helper on /pacientes hero, left-aligned Pacientes/Empresas heroes, animated como-flow with icons + numbered steps, real profile explorer with modal). All 13 requested checks passed. Modal opens correctly for all profiles, closes via close button, overlay click, and Escape key. Bienestar masculino elite shows background image. Salud femenina premium modal renders its own study groups (hemograma, TSH, estradiol, etc.). Lang toggle works and study names remain in Spanish in EN mode as intended. Menu PDF (/assets/menus/menu-es.pdf) and all 52 laboral logos (/assets/laboral/laboral-XX.jpg) respond 200. Mobile 390x844: WhatsApp float and back-to-top do not overlap; personas-hero centers on mobile (text-align: center). Backend /api/health returns {status: healthy}.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal close via keyboard/close-button works but if the click is fired during the AnimatePresence enter animation (~<500ms) the state update can be swallowed. Not a functional bug but a UX polish opportunity: disable interactive events until the enter animation finishes or use pointerEvents:'none' during initial mount.
PATIENT_PROFILES currently has only one card with a real image (bienestar-masculino-elite); the remaining 11 use gradient accents. Confirmed as expected per client (rest of images pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 acceptance criteria in this iteration pass. When testing modal close mechanisms, wait ~600ms after opening (AnimatePresence enter animation) before clicking close controls; clicking too fast with force=True during entrance can cause the first close event to be missed. profiles are in /app/frontend/src/data.js (PATIENT_PROFILES). Modal component: /app/frontend/src/components/ProfileExplorer.jsx.
